description: Frozen rank-four later-head gauges. For each held-out token edit, compare selected task axis against eight Haar axes preselected by the largest local post-c_proj edit dose, with both interventions scaled to the exact smaller dose for that pair. Finite full-model correct-minus-foil margin changes are oriented by the full rank-four path sign. This is a within-reduced-model causal-dose comparison, not a physical necessity test.
random_axis_selection: best mean absolute local task effect on discovery pairs for each random rotation
